subject: Future Tech
title: 3D-Printed Houses
description: A fast breakdown of 3D-Printed Houses for builders.

hook.text: ICON built a 3D-printed house in Austin, Texas in just 48 hours of print time using a giant concrete-extruding robot.

buildup.text: The printer is called Vulcan. It squeezes layers of a special concrete mix and builds walls up to the roof line.

discovery.text: 3D-printed homes use 30% fewer materials than conventional construction and generate far less waste on the job site.

twist.text: Labor is the construction industry's biggest cost and bottleneck.

climax.text: ICON built an entire community of 3D-printed homes in Texas. Prices started at $450,000, with plans to go much lower.

punchline.text: Your next house might come from a nozzle, not a hammer.
